source_paper.title: Modeling Localized PPG for Blood Pressure Forecasting With MoE and Quantile Regression
source_paper.source_protocol: 60 s PPG, 30 s stride, target average 4 min 40 s to 5 min 20 s after history end
source_paper.source_validation_warning: 50% overlapping samples randomly shuffled into an 80/20 split; no patient-separated test or persistence baseline reported

pilot_scope.dataset: University of Queensland Vital Signs Dataset
pilot_scope.calibration_input: current NBP used only for residual/calibration-lite mode

candidate_method.name: Tiny transition-aware residual PPG forecaster
candidate_method.features: 108 morphology, derivative, spectrum, pulse and six-subwindow drift features
candidate_method.target: primary calibration-lite mode: future BP minus current BP; secondary PPG-only mode: absolute future BP

promotion_gate: Positive mean transition skill for both SBP and DBP under patient-group CV; otherwise no accuracy-improvement claim
scientific_position: A pilot can establish feasibility or expose protocol leakage; it cannot establish clinical validity from only ten minutes per patient.
